sourceReview: Genuine cold protected-runtime startup against a preexisting selected broker and stored health record. An externally held final role lease blocks all role spawning while the actual creator-proven host holds earlier startup leases. Only its retained native proof authorizes failure injection. Original shutdown deadline covers frontend join, host exit and lease release; retry must establish a new owner/attempt and all four ready roles. Failure paths retain the exact gate if host exit is uncertain.
limitations: Compile-only evidence does not establish startup owner death, lease release, retry or persistence preservation on the installed target.
This is not cold broker creation or owner death after a proper subset of role children has spawned. Separate supervisor rollback controls cover different boundaries.
Private strong references retain an uncertain gate only for the test-process lifetime; unknown cleanup is failed evidence, never acceptance.
Actual protected installation, supported SDK admission and complete real Docker execution remain required.
